NOTE
**Still not ready: no new push, and the AI-policy feedback is unanswered**

New: The author posted two screenshots in a comment and apologized, but the code is unchanged since the feedback. Missing: any sign they understand the change, such as why `ui_init.js` was touched. The PR description still has the screenshot placeholder. Open PR #39758 already makes the same change in the same two files.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it unassigned, and ask the author to coordinate with #39758 before anyone spends review time.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Please put them in the PR description, and explain in your own words what the change does and why `ui_init.js` is touched, per the [AI use policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines). Also note that #39758 is already open for this same issue and touches the same files, so please check how your PR relates to it.
```
